comment.narrative: he stakeholder analysis identified critical disparities in resource distribution opportunities constraints and power dynamics among women men girls and boys. These insights shaped a robust inclusion strategy and actionable plans ensuring gendersensitive approaches across all intervention areas.Key highlights includedBarriers Identified Women and girls in rural areas faced limited access to decisionmaking spaces and resources impacting their ability to engage in mediation and peacebuilding roles effectively.Strategic Responses Tailored gendersensitive training modules and contextspecific inclusion strategies addressed these barriers equipping women mediators with the skills to navigate challenges.Actionable Plans Gender inclusion was embedded in all activities including communitylevel engagement localized mediation approaches and tailored mentorship programs. Measurable indicators tracked progress in promoting equitable participation.These strategies ensured the intervention did not only include women and girls but actively empowered them to take leadership roles fostering a more inclusive and sustainable approach to peacebuilding.
